name: Chinatown
summary: NEL/DTL heritage and food belt — shophouse edges, dense condo inserts, and tourist footfall with shorter CBD hops than far-east towns.
body: Chinatown is the shortlist when North-East / Downtown Line access and heritage food density matter more than polished Orchard living. Housing mixes shophouse walk-ups, boutique condos, and towers toward Outram / Maxwell; weekend tourist crowds and festival evenings are the tax. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops, late kitchens, and rents that still undercut River Valley. Compare with Outram for a slightly more hospital / interchange feel, Tanjong Pagar for CBD-south office gravity, and Tiong Bahru when you want café heritage with a calmer residential grid.
bestFor: car-light CBD workers who want food and heritage nearby
households okay with weekend tourist energy
condo renters who will vet MA facility booking rules
people who will book ActiveSG indoor halls instead of trusting condo games rooms
housingMix: Shophouse walk-ups, boutique condos, and towers toward Outram / Maxwell.
commuteNotes: North-East and Downtown Line at Chinatown; test a Saturday afternoon street-level walk before you romanticise the heritage belt.
